channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: Nissan Kicks e-POWER arrives from ₱1.499M
item.description: Nissan Philippines has launched the all-new Kicks e-POWER with introductory prices starting at ₱1.499 million. item.title: MINI Victory Edition lands in PH
item.description: The Philippines has received its only allocation of the MINI 1965 Victory Edition, but the one-off model was already claimed before its official local launch. item.title: Green GSM Launches Premium Taxi Service In The Philippines
item.description: Green GSM, an all-electric ride-hailing platform, launched Premium Taxi, an upscale seven-seat taxi service in the Philippines. Using the VinFast Limo Green, the service is designed set a new standard for the high-end electric taxi segment in the market. Read More »

item.title: CAMPI reports July sales rise
item.description: Philippine vehicle sales increased for a third straight month in July, with the industry posting its highest monthly total so far in 2026.

item.title: Caltex links fuel quality to engine care
item.description: Motorists often pay close attention to oil changes, tire pressure and scheduled maintenance, but the fuel that goes into the tank also affects how an engine performs over time.

item.title: Greenstrum builds business EV networks
item.description: ACMobility subsidiary Greenstrum has expanded its electric vehicle charging services for companies that want to own and operate their own charging networks.

item.title: Toyota adds free roadside assistance
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines has partnered with the Automobile Association Philippines (AAP) to provide free 24-hour emergency roadside assistance to eligible Toyota owners nationwide.

item.title: Volvo XC90 T8 PHEV voted best seven-seater
item.description: Volvo’s XC90 T8 plug-in hybrid has been named Best Seven-Seater Car 2026 at the Auto Trader Drivers’ Choice Awards in the United Kingdom.

item.title: Honda gets streetwise
item.description: Honda Philippines Inc. (HPI) has added the Click125 Street to its established scooter range. The new model gives the familiar 125cc scooter a different riding position and sharper appearance without changing its basic commuter formula.

item.title: Pato O’Ward Wins IndyCar’s Milwaukee Mile Race 2 While Leading Race 1
item.description: The McLaren driver has a chance to become the first IndyCar driver to win two races in the same day when Race 2 resumes with 159 laps remaining.

item.title: Elon Musk Saying 'All Cars' Will Have Starlink As The 'Only Way' To Connect Them Sounds More Like Threat Than Promise
item.description: Starlink has already been spotted on the roof of a Cybercab, but if the owner of both companies has his way, it'll be a much more ubiquitous technology.

item.title: 21 Rich Guys Got Genesis To Launch A Bespoke Program In The Middle East, America Is Next
item.description: The GV90 launch revealed Genesis is tailoring its ultra-luxury One of One service for U.S. buyers
